arguments.Title: 전경 복귀와 지도 조작 검증
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Cinemachine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var hud=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); foreach(var b in Object.FindObjectsByType<CinemachineBrain>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) result.Log("active="+b.ActiveVirtualCamera?.Name+" enabled="+b.enabled+" orthographic="+b.GetComponent<Camera>().orthographic); hud.OperatorControls.Pan(new Vector2(50,20)); hud.OperatorControls.Rotate(new Vector2(30,0)); hud.OperatorControls.Zoom(.8f); result.Log("navigation commands sent"); } }
